about_the_game:
Soloria is a perfect replica of a MMORPG, without all of the pesky 'online' features. Adventure, level up, grind gear, and explore in this simulation of a massively multiplayer online role-playing experience. 

Solarpunk Storytelling

On the paradise planet of Acropolis, energy is nearly infinite. Great machines from the mysterious Creators churn endlessly, generating power from solar, thermal, and hydro sources. However, rumors of a new energy source on the mysterious Wyldland continent - a corrupting power capable of powering ancient weapons - threaten the peace Acropolis has enjoyed for centuries. You are a Wylder, an explorer of this futuristic frontier, in the service of one of the three great Guilds, and your mission is to investigate these bold claims of new energy. Will you discover this mysterious new power, and if you do, what would it mean for the planet's ecosystem, politics, and future?

An Immersive Simulation

The other "players" of Soloria have varying personalities, priorities, and skill levels to simulate the population of a thriving MMORPG. If you find a player in the open world you like fighting alongside, add them to your Friends List to call upon them later in instanced content.

Engaging and Complex Buildcraft

Your characters in Soloria are classless - instead of a rigid system that associates certain builds with certain abilities, your characters are free to spend points in any Talent Tree they have unlocked. New Talent Trees are earned directly from gameplay and can be swapped out at any time in the open world.

Freeform Itemization

Any character in Soloria can use any piece of equipment, regardless of what Talent Trees they have equipped. Your build is defined by what you can find, either from clearing raids or from the Auction House. 

Relaxed MMORPG Gameplay

Unlike a real online game, Soloria is built for you to advance at your own pace. You'll always be able to find other players to clear the content you're trying to master, and the meta will never shift out from under your feet. It's a game that matches your speed and your skill without rushing you along or leaving you behind.

Open World Exploration

The open world of Soloria rewards you for exploring it. Hunt for secrets and achievements in every nook and cranny of this handcrafted experience.

name: Soloria
short_description: Ever feel like online games are a little too online these days? Why not try a FMMORPG - a Fake Massively Multiplayer Offline Role-Playing Game - and live out your online game dreams in an offline game space. Interact with other (fake) players, fight raid bosses, explore, and advance!
